Estimate and Remove Ambient RNA Contamination

Source: R/Pre-processing_soupX.R
estimate_contamination.Rd

Integrates SoupChannel objects with initial high-resolution clustering to automatically estimate the ambient RNA contamination fraction (rho) via SoupX::autoEstCont(). Includes a robust manual override system allowing you to artificially increase the estimated contamination fraction (e.g., adding 5% extra background removal) either globally across all samples or selectively for specific noisy samples. Finally, it applies the chosen correction method to remove the background noise and returns the cleaned count matrices.

Usage

estimate_contamination(
  soup_list,
  seurat_list,
  cts_filtered_list,
  sample_names,
  mulFac = 0,
  manual_contam = list(),
  manual = FALSE,
  methods = "subtraction",
  pCut = 0.01
)

Arguments

soup_list

A named list of SoupChannel objects, typically generated by create_soup_channels().

seurat_list

A named list of clustered Seurat objects, typically generated by create_seurat_for_clustering(). Used solely to supply high-resolution cluster identities back to the SoupChannels.

cts_filtered_list

A named list of filtered sparse count matrices. Used to extract the exact cell barcodes to ensure 1:1 mapping with the clusters.

sample_names

Character vector. A list of sample identifiers corresponding to the names in the input lists.

mulFac

Numeric. A percentage to artificially add to the auto-estimated contamination fraction (e.g., mulFac = 5 adds 0.05 to the rho value). Default is 0.

manual_contam

Character vector. A list of specific sample names to apply the mulFac adjustment to. Only evaluated if manual = TRUE. Default is an empty list.

manual

Logical. Controls the application of mulFac. If FALSE, mulFac is applied globally to ALL samples. If TRUE, mulFac is applied ONLY to the specific samples listed in manual_contam. Default is FALSE.

methods

Character. The method to use for count adjustment passed to SoupX::adjustCounts(). Options include "subtraction", "soupOnly", or "multinomial". Default is "subtraction".

pCut

Numeric. The p-value threshold used for identifying cells expressing genes above background levels when methods = "soupOnly". Default is 0.01.

Value

A named list containing two elements:

  • soup_list_all: A list of the updated SoupChannel objects with their final rho values calculated and set.

  • corrected_list: A list of the final, decontaminated sparse count matrices (rounded to integers), ready to be used to create your final Seurat objects.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Assuming soup_channels and seurat_clusters were generated previously

# Example 1: Run standard auto-estimation with no manual overrides
clean_data <- estimate_contamination(
  soup_list = soup_channels,
  seurat_list = initial_seurat_objs,
  cts_filtered_list = counts_list$filtered,
  sample_names = my_samples,
  methods = "subtraction"
)

# Example 2: Sample "Patient_3" looks particularly noisy.
# Add an extra 5% (0.05) to its estimated contamination fraction.
clean_data_adjusted <- estimate_contamination(
  soup_list = soup_channels,
  seurat_list = initial_seurat_objs,
  cts_filtered_list = counts_list$filtered,
  sample_names = my_samples,
  mulFac = 5,
  manual = TRUE,
  manual_contam = c("Patient_3")
)

# Extract the cleaned matrix for downstream processing
p3_clean_matrix <- clean_data_adjusted$corrected_list[["Patient_3"]]
} # }
